app CohortJourney
Given
 Container {name:text}
 Entry in Container {label:text,applicable:bool=true,consent:bool=true,count:int=0}
 event Sweep {marker:text}
 event Scoped {container:Container,marker:text}
 policy Container read=members
 policy Entry read=members
When
 crud Container by=owner fields=name
 crud Entry by=owner fields=label,applicable,consent
 scenario sweep on=Sweep each=Entry as entry
  do
   require actor==null
   require operation.source=="schedule"
   require entry.applicable
   set entry {count=entry.count+1,label=event.marker}
   require entry.consent
 scenario scoped on=Scoped each=event.container.Entry as entry
  do
   require actor==null
   require operation.source=="schedule"
   require entry.parent==event.container
   set entry {count=entry.count+1,label=event.marker}
 scenario unbound on=Sweep each=Entry
  do
   require actor==null
   require operation.source=="schedule"
   let marker=event.marker
Then
